displayName: OCI-AI-RAG-001: AI — RAG Pipeline Data Poisoning
description:
Detects injection of malicious content into RAG knowledge bases that corrupts retrieval output

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_rag_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%rag%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%pipeline%') AND "value" > 0
dataSourceDetails.originalQuery: SELECT "siem_general_ai_rag_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%rag%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%pipeline%') AND "value" > 0
